title: Ellie found out Joel's lie in The Last of Us Part II
subject: ellie
description:
Would you have forgiven Joel after hearing that? 👇

The flashback where Ellie learns what really happened at the hospital. Spoilers for The Last of Us Part I and Part II.

scenes.text: The truth was waiting at St. Mary's Hospital.
Ellie was 14 when Joel carried her out. Years later, she rode back alone to Salt Lake City.
The Fireflies were gone, but the operating room they had prepared for her was still there.
Back in Jackson, she asked Joel what really happened. This time he told her.
"If somehow the Lord gave me a second chance at that moment, I would do it all over again."
Ellie said her life could have mattered. After that, she kept her distance.
Players see this scene only after Joel's death.
